notes.title: New Patch: Controller support is available now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478570/5de978790b72d1c42512f6e7c8ef9f5b33957f68.png

Hello everyone!

Since the game launch I published some lite updates without any announcements. But this patch is different, so I want to make it special. I'm happy to announce the controller support is available now! Detailed list of changes read below.

Patch note:

Implemented controller support.
Fixed mirror rotation speed.
Fixed player jittering.
Some puzzles have been remade.
Springboard in combination with teleports have been remade.
Disabled manual trajectory for throwing objects.
Fixed minor bugs.


Thank you for playing!
